name: Web Scraper
description: Built to handle real, large datasets smoothly — Results stay responsive no matter how many rows you collect, exports always include everything you scraped, and the whole extension has been audited end-to-end for performance, accessibility, and reliability. Export exactly the data you need — pick which columns to include, choose CSV/Excel/JSON/NDJSON with a configurable delimiter, freeze-header and autofilter-ready spreadsheets, safe filename templates, optional raw-value columns alongside your cleaned data, and formula-injection-safe CSV output. Clean and normalize your data with a full transform pipeline — trim/case/regex/split/merge, Normalize Number/Currency/Percentage/Date/Boolean, extract a domain, fill missing values, and derive a brand-new column while always keeping your raw scraped value intact, all reorderable and toggleable with a live before/after preview. Start from a ready-made Template (E-commerce, Search Results, Articles, Directories, Real Estate, Jobs, Tables, or generic Lists) or build your own — save any scraper, transforms included, as a reusable, editable Template. Auto-detect or manually select repeating elements on any web page, or pull structured data (JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter Card, and common meta tags) straight off the page with no selector needed. Save reusable scrapers mixing both, and collect data across many pages automatically — Auto Scroll / Infinite Scroll, Multi-Page pagination (Next-button or URL-pattern), and Load More button loops, with conservative pagination auto-detect, Pause/Resume, and configurable retries with exponential backoff. Follow a Link column out to each detail page and merge extra fields back into the same table (Deep Scraping, with configurable retry limits and a Retry Failed option), bulk-download images or files as a single ZIP archive, compare scrape results over time with snapshots and change detection, monitor saved scrapers automatically on a schedule with a run history log and a summary dashboard, get notified when a monitored run finds changes, and build a structured research dataset bundle (manifests + linked images/files, packaged as one ZIP download) from any scrape. Every feature is available from install with a free trial of 10 scraping runs; a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited use. No coding required.
